title: Making a marble run
examples: Teacher, what is the best angle for the slide?
If I make the track wider, will it go faster?
How do I make the marble turn without stopping?

explain.say: Today you will build a marble run.
First, plan the slopes. Gravity pulls the marble down each slope.
A steeper slope makes the marble go faster.
Next, plan the turns. Gentle turns keep the marble on the track.
Always test your run. Then fix the parts that do not work.
In real life, water slides use slopes and turns too.

draw.text: Water slides use slopes and turns

faq.q: Does the angle of the slope matter more than the length?
faq.a: Yes. A steeper slope makes the marble go faster, even on a shorter run.
asks: Is steepness more important than distance?
Which makes it go faster, angle or length?

faq.q: What is the best kind of turn to use?
faq.a: A gentle curve is best. It keeps the marble moving smoothly.
asks: Should the turn be sharp or round?
How do I make a smooth corner?

faq.q: If it stops, should I just add more slope?
faq.a: Sometimes more slope helps. Also check if a turn is too tight.
asks: Does it stop because of the turn?

faq.q: Do I need to use the same material for everything?
faq.a: No. You can use different materials for different parts. Then test how they work together.
asks: Can I use cardboard and plastic?

faq.q: How do I make it go further?
faq.a: Try making the slope steeper or adding more length to the track. You can also check if the turns are too sharp.
asks: What makes the marble travel farther?
How do I increase the distance?

facts: Gravity pulls the marble down the slope.
A steeper slope increases the marble's speed.
Gentle curves help the marble keep its speed.
Testing and fixing is part of engineering.

quiz.say: You want the marble to go fast. Which slope should you build?
quiz.why: Gravity pulls the marble faster down a steep slope.

wrong.0: On a flat track, the marble slows down and stops.
wrong.1: A gentle slope makes the marble roll slowly.

quiz.say: Which kind of turn keeps the marble on the track?
quiz.why: A gentle curve lets the marble turn smoothly and stay on the track.

wrong.0: At a sharp corner, the marble can fly off the track.
wrong.2: A zigzag has lots of sharp corners, so the marble may fall off.

quiz.say: Your marble keeps falling off at one turn. What should you do next?
quiz.show: 🔵 It falls off at one turn.

options.show: find the problem and fix it
options.say: find the problem and fix it

quiz.why: Testing shows the problem. Then you change that part and test again.

wrong.1: Every builder has problems, so look at that turn and try again.
wrong.2: A taller run makes the marble faster, so it may fall off more.
